params.body:
Replaces #132: same change, without "Wat opvalt".

Verkennen held what happened per project, person, machine and material, and was where one of them opens with its days and its handover context; Netwerk and Bespreken already linked to it for that. Its name did not say so, and a second menu "Patronen over alles heen" listed three other ways of looking at the same data as if they were separate things.

## What changes

- **Historiek.** Page, menu, links ("Openen in historiek") and the share text use the new name. Intro: "Wat er gebeurd is, per project, persoon, machine en materiaal, uit Bouwsoft en de fiches." The address is `/historiek`; `/verkennen`, its printout and CSV redirect with their query, and shared links on the old path still open.
- **No patterns group.** Tijdlijn is a Lijst/Tijdlijn switch on Projecten, Wie met wie a Lijst/Wie met wie switch on Mensen. The drivers per machine already sit in Machines.
- **Opvallend is gone.** The findings (vaste ploeg, kennis bij één persoon, stilgevallen, ritme van de week, ...) analysed the business rather than served the handover. Removed with `Lenses::findings` and its helpers; `?per=opvallend` opens Historiek on its default table.
- **Relaties and Offertes** leave Historiek; Netwerk has both. `?per=relaties|offertes` opens Netwerk.
- **Printout.** Findings no longer head the paper. A printout with one project or person open prints its days, as on screen.
- Smaller: day counts in Wie met wie no longer wrap, the agenda intro on Bespreken is one line, two "Tik op ..." hints and a gendered "zijn" are gone.

Route names stay `office.explore*`, so nothing else moves. No migration.

## Tests

Full suite passes locally (333). New: old addresses open where things live now. Tests that asserted Relaties, Offertes, Opvallend or the old path are updated.
